title: Chapter 2575: Tian Yuchen
content:
Chapter 2575: Tian Yuchen

"So I can only do this fifty times a month, huh? What a pity," Yuan sighed out loud after seeing the notification, as he was beginning to get the hang of the 46th floor.

’With that said... I don’t think I can clear the 46th stage simply by brute forcing it,’ he thought inwardly as he exited the waiting room.

"Anyway, now that it’s a new month, I can continue matchmaking for One Above All and Last Man Standing."

But before he continued matchmaking, Yuan made his way to the exchange to purchase some items with the points he’d amassed from Last Man Standing and Endless Assault.

<Reading Player Status>

<Available Gaia’s Points: 575,533>

<Welcome to Gaia’s Exchange, Player Yuan>

"Half a million, huh?"

He thought Last Man Standing rewarded a lot of points, but it turns out that Endless Assault rewarded the most points, with floors 41st and onward rewarding over 50,000 points.

<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(2) for 10,000 Gaia Points>

<Confirmed>

<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(2)>

The first thing Yuan purchased was the second part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, as he wanted to see how it differed from part one and whether he should continue collecting the other parts.

’Interesting... although the second part appears gibberish at a glance, if combined with the first part, it greatly improves the technique’s efficiency and speed.’

In the end, Yuan decided to finish the collection. However, he was only able to purchase one more since the final part was too expensive for him at the moment.

<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(3) for 150,000 Gaia Points>

<Confirmed>

<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(3)>

The final part of the technique required 750,000 points, so Yuan decided to put it on hold for now and purchase something else that would directly benefit him.

<Confirm Purchase of Superior Gaia’s Gift for 75,000 points?>

<Confirmed>

<You have purchased Superior Gaia’s Gift>

After purchasing the treasure, Yuan heard something small drop from the machine. When he looked down, he saw that it had produced the treasure.

He grabbed the Superior Gaia’s Gift and, without hesitation, tossed it into his mouth as if it were a piece of candy.

<You have consumed Superior Gaia’s Gift>

<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>

[Cultivation Speed: 4]

Since he still had plenty of points, Yuan purchased another one.

<You have consumed Superior Gaia’s Gift>

<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>

[Cultivation Speed: 5]

After some consideration, Yuan decided to purchase another one.

<You have consumed Superior Gaia’s Gift>

<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>

[Cultivation Speed: 6]

Most people would not consume so much Gaia’s Gift at once since they needed to have the proper physique. However, Yuan was already at Perfected Heavenly Refinement, so he wasn’t worried that his cultivation speed might be bottlenecked by it.

’Wow! This feels great!’ Yuan thought to himself as he examined his own body.

With his current cultivation speed, it rivaled his true cultivation speed in the Nine Heavens.

No... it even surpassed it!

Once he was done, Yuan immediately made his way to the matchmaking room for One Above All.

However, on his way there, he noticed a massive crowd gathered.

With his interest piqued, Yuan approached the crowd to see what they were all looking at.

That was when he discovered the rankings.

"He’s not moving past the 46th floor... do you think he’s reached his peak?"

"Give it a few more days. It took him several days to clear the 45th floor, after all."

"..."

Yuan ignored the crowd’s chatter and focused on the Endless Assault leaderboard.

"What...?" Yuan muttered in surprise when he saw the ranking and that there were four people ahead of him—technically two since the other two were also stuck on the 46th floor. But since they’d reached it earlier than Yuan, they were above his name.

’There are eight other people who have cleared past the 40th floor, and four of them have even cleared past the 45th floor?!’

’Not just that, but someone has reached all the way to the 50th floor?!’

Yuan narrowed his eyes at the name on the top of the leaderboard and swallowed nervously.

’Tian... Yuchen?’

The surname ’Tian’ made him wonder if it was just a coincidence or if they had a connection with him.

’50th floor... I cannot even imagine how powerful the enemy would be on the 47th floor, much less the 50th floor!’ Yuan shook his head inwardly.

Yuan did not linger and left the crowd shortly after, entering One Above All to matchmake.

A week later—

<You have won your match>

<You are on a winning streak!>

<Win Streak: 300>

<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>

<You have received Limitless as a reward>

<You have earned 50 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>

<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>

<You have reached Eighth Level Fourth Ascension>

<You have reached Master Rank>

After reaching his monthly limit for One Above All, Yuan made his way to Last Man Standing.

<You have won your match>

<You are on a winning streak!>

<Win Streak: 200>

<You have defeated 38 players>

<You have earned 38 Gaia Points>

<You have earned 50 Gaia Points for being the last man standing>

<You have received Limitless as a reward>

<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>

<You have earned 200 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>

<You have reached First Level Fifth Ascension>

<You have reached Master Rank>

’Oh? I am already at Master Rank?’ Yuan had anticipated it would take another hundred wins to reach Master, but it seemed like one could rank up faster in Last Man Standing than One Above All.

Now that he’d reached the monthly limit for both One Above All and Last Man Standing, Yuan prepared to challenge the 46th floor again. However, rather than rushing to fight it, he spent time studying the Limitless Cultivation Technique.

’It’s unlikely that the people of this world can use Eternal Essence, so Tian Yuchen must’ve reached the 50th floor using Limitless alone. In that case... I must figure out how he achieved it!’ Yuan thought to himself.
